finding: warp-reduce body is 2.45x faster than the bitwise serial chain for 1x4096 (2.08 vs 5.09 us) but only 1.08x for q/k 32x128/8x128. fp16-output norms (ffn/attn) are bitwise-identical (no SHA flip); fp32-output norms (q/k/output) flip. The big 1x4096 win is therefore NOT gated on the bitwise contract for fp16 norms - it is gated on the opaque-boundary materialization (+142us / 144 copies from M3 record).
